# Pitch API

Pitch is one usage-metered studio with one agent. A project is a workspace and a resumable conversation. The prompt and uploaded files determine which tools the agent uses; callers do not select a flow.

API: https://api.trypitch.co/v1
MCP: POST https://api.trypitch.co/mcp
Auth: Authorization: Bearer pk_... or X-API-Key: pk_...

REST:
- POST /v1/projects: { prompt?, options?, uploads?, name? }. Prompt is required unless uploads are present. A legacy optional flow field is accepted but ignored.
- GET /v1/projects?limit=50: { data, total }. Limit is 1-100.
- GET /v1/projects/{id}
- POST /v1/projects/{id}/prompt: { text, scene?, slide?, delivery?: "queue"|"steer" }
- POST /v1/projects/{id}/export: { res?: "720p"|"1080p"|"4k" }
- GET /v1/projects/{id}/export
- GET /v1/credits
- GET /v1/pricing (public)

MCP tools: create_project, prompt_project, get_project, list_projects, export_project, export_status, get_credits, get_pricing.

Creation, prompts, and exports are billed by model spend and host compute. Reads are free. Poll project status until ready or failed. Active prompts queue by default; delivery "steer" redirects active work. There are no idempotency keys.

Uploads are base64 { fileBase64, fileName }. Accepted: PDF, PPTX, PNG, JPG, JPEG, WEBP, MP4, WEBM, MOV, MKV, AVI. Documents/images: 50 MB. Videos: 500 MB. Whole request: 750 MB.

Full docs: https://trypitch.co/docs
